item.title: AI isn't just a tool and it might be dangerous
Show HN: AI investment agreement review for startup founders
item.description:
Hi HN! First, congrats to the founders who received a term sheet(and those who will!)

I made an investment agreement review tool for founders who recently received a term sheet! You can review your term sheets, SAFEs, convertible notes, and financing agreements if your corporation is incorporated in Delaware, from pre-seed through Series A.

It also reviews equity purchase agreements, investor rights, voting terms, and side letters.

Try it and check your potential risks before signing!
